mode: ask
description: "Generate a polished website feature section for WeFitNest using project style and content rules."
Create one complete feature section for the WeFitNest marketing site.

Inputs:

Feature name
User outcome
Core actions in this feature
Supporting screenshot filename if available
Output requirements:

Section headline and subheadline
Benefit-oriented copy
3 to 5 concise bullet points describing capability
Step-by-step mini walkthrough
CTA line connecting to App Store action
Suggested visual layout direction for mobile and desktop
Accessibility notes for this section
Constraints:

Keep style aligned with WeFitNest premium athletic brand
Use token-first styling mindset
Avoid generic marketing fluff
Keep text concise and practical
